Container.Name: NexusBackup
Container.Overview: Nexus Backup is a self-contained local-first backup, recovery and transfer appliance for Unraid. One container runs the dashboard/control plane, local execution agent and TLS Restic workstation repository endpoint as coordinated internal services. The Repository may be used directly from the Internet over TLS without a VPN or cloud data proxy.
Container.Requires: Set Repository endpoint host to the DNS name or IPv4 address Windows workstations actually use. Internet exposure should use a stable public DNS name/IP plus a router/firewall port forward to the Repository listen port. Review source, backup, restore and download mappings before enabling jobs. Only add SYS_ADMIN and /dev/fuse manually if you deliberately enable the optional rclone-mounted remote-source feature.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent Nexus configuration. Internally separated into Control, Agent and Repository subdirectories. Repository TLS keys and transport credentials under this path are secrets.

Config.Name: Agent state/cache
Config.Description: Persistent rclone VFS, mount state and Restic cache. May be placed on cache storage.

Config.Name: Backup source root
Config.Description: Read-only host data visible to generic Nexus backup jobs. Point this at the specific share/directory to protect; avoid mapping the whole /mnt/user tree unless deliberately required.

Config.Name: Backup repository root
Config.Description: Nexus-managed backup storage. Generic repositories use /backup/generic and Windows workstation repositories use /backup/workstations.

Config.Name: Restore staging root
Config.Description: Host staging area for restore jobs. Nexus writes only fresh generated staging directories here; restores are never in-place.

Config.Name: Transfer destination root
Config.Description: Default local destination root for managed Copyarr-style transfers. Change this to the intended import/download share.

Config.Name: Repository exposure
Config.Description: Initial Repository exposure policy: lan or internet. Internet mode defaults append-only on first start. Persistent settings later live under /config/repository/settings and are managed by Nexus.

Config.Name: Repository endpoint host
Config.Description: Canonical DNS name or IPv4 address used by workstations. For Internet mode use the public/DDNS hostname. This identity is pinned in the self-signed Repository TLS certificate.

Config.Name: Repository listen port
Config.Description: Local TLS Restic REST port on Unraid.

Config.Name: Repository endpoint port
Config.Description: Port advertised to workstations. May differ from the local listen port, for example WAN 443 forwarded to Unraid 8000.

Config.Name: Repository append-only
Config.Description: Optional initial override: true or false. If left blank, first-start Internet mode defaults to true and LAN mode to false. Append-only permits new backups while preventing deletion/modification through the remote REST endpoint.

Config.Name: Initial workstation user
Config.Description: Creates one initial private REST transport principal if missing. Additional per-workstation users can be created from the NexusBackup container console with nexus-repository-client.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Optional explicit external http(s) origin for the Control UI/install path. This is separate from the Repository endpoint. Forwarded Host/Proto headers are intentionally ignored.
